It reminds us of the divine promise that Allah, the Almighty, is the true protector and defender of His believers. The name Khandawar can serve as an inspiration for individuals to strive towards becoming a source of protection and comfort for others, reflecting the compassion and mercy inherent in the Islamic faith.
